wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 03-009 maps every launch-host quit trigger onto the correct QuitFlow drain via a new src/vanilla facade (cleanQuitAndEndoom.ts) that re-exports the quit/ENDOOM surface through the 07-010 facade (./wireQuitAndEndoomUi.ts) rather than importing the read-only src/ui/endoom.ts and src/bootstrap/quitFlow.ts a second time. It adds QuitTrigger ('fatalError' | 'menuQuitConfirmed' | 'normalQuit' | 'windowClose'), resolveQuitPlan (the three clean triggers collapse onto the I_Quit path: full LIFO executeQuit drain, ENDOOM presented, exit 0; fatalError uses executeErrorQuit, no ENDOOM presentation, exit 1), runQuitPlan (drains the correct path and returns the executed step order), and the frozen VANILLA_CLEAN_QUIT_INVARIANTS pinning four launch-host parity rules anchored to Chocolate Doom 2.2.1 i_system.c I_Quit/I_Error, m_menu.c M_QuitResponse, and the SDL window-close -> SDL_QUIT -> I_Quit translation. The actual Win32 message-pump / exit() call stays in src/launcher/win32.ts (FFI is not unit-testable without a real window). The focused test exercises resolveQuitPlan for all four triggers, runQuitPlan LIFO drain vs error drain, frozen-manifest shape, line-anchored import-specifier routing (only ./wireQuitAndEndoomUi.ts), and same-reference identity with the 07-010 facade.
wiringInterpretation.inventoryNeutralityNote: Facade routes through ./wireQuitAndEndoomUi.ts and the focused test uses a line-anchored regex (no embedded 'from ...endoom.ts' / 'from ...quitFlow.ts' literal), so the UI inventory countImporters heuristic is not triggered. plan_vanilla_parity/current-state/inventory-ui-modules.json is unchanged, matching the 03-006/03-007 launch-lane no-inventory-rewrite precedent. src/vanilla/ and test/plan_final/launch/ are not plan_vanilla_parity source_roots/test_roots entries.
